jobs.title: Electrical Technician
jobs.description: Responsible for performing electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and inspection of machines and equipment to ensure safe, efficient, and continuous plant operations. Key Responsibilities: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical systems, machines, and equipment. Troubleshoot and repair electrical and electronic faults in machines and equipment. Conduct regular inspection to ensure proper machine operation and electrical safety. Assist in machine installation, wiring, testing, and commissioning. Monitor machine performance and identify potential electrical or mechanical issues. Provide technical support during machine breakdowns and production operations. Ensure proper maintenance of tools, equipment, and work areas. Follow company maintenance procedures, GMP, HACCP, 5S, and workplace safety standards. Perform other maintenance-related tasks as assigned by the immediate supervisor.

jobs.title: Audit Specialist
jobs.description: Responsible for conducting independent audits of warehouse operations, inventory transactions, and documentation to ensure inventory accuracy, compliance with company policies and procedures, and effectiveness of internal controls. The role involves physical inventory verification, transaction testing, reconciliation of inventory records, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions to minimize discrepancies and operational risks. Key Responsibilities: Conduct regular physical inventory counts and verify actual stocks against Oracle/ERP system records. Audit receiving, storage, issuance, production returns, and dispatch transactions. Review and validate supporting documents, inventory records, and warehouse transactions. Investigate inventory discrepancies, including shortages, overages, unrecorded items, and recurring variances. Monitor the movement and accountability of raw materials, packaging materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and spare parts. Evaluate warehouse documentation, system records, authorization, and compliance with established procedures. Identify operational risks, control weaknesses, and potential inventory losses. Monitor corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Prepare clear and accurate audit reports with findings and recommendations. Coordinate with warehouse, production, and other departments regarding audit findings and follow-up activities.

Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines.
